name: Shinka Jikkyou -Pandora no Hako-
original_name: 進化実況 —パンドラの箱—
source:
Kouichi Itoda.
He was an introverted type.
In spite of this he had a girlfriend from
the same class, who was beautiful, kind,
and rather out of his league.
Kouichi worried about this a lot.

One day an incident happened near the school.
A package arrived from one of her male friends.
Kouichi was suspicious and opened it...
That was the night it all went to hell.

His false happiness was obliterated.
Faced with a choice.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE096907.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
糸田浩一.
他是一个内向的人。
尽管如此，他还是有一个女朋友
同班的，漂亮，善良，
而且不在他的范围之内。
康一对此非常担心。

有一天，学校附近发生了一起事件。
她的一位男性朋友寄来了一个包裹。
幸一疑惑地打开了……
那天晚上，一切都陷入了地狱。

他虚假的幸福被抹去了。
面临选择。
